sources.title: Introducing: Devstral 2 and Mistral Vibe CLI.
sources.evidence: Dated December 9, 2025, the announcement releases the Devstral family in 123B and 24B sizes. It identifies Small 2 as the 24B Apache-2.0 model, with 256K context and image inputs for multimodal software agents.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct 2512 — official model card
sources.evidence: Exact FP8 instruction checkpoint: nominal 24 billion parameters, Apache-2.0 metadata and license statement, image and text understanding, repository exploration and file editing. Provides native function schemas/tool-call parser and text-generation examples. The vLLM serving example sets --max-model-len 262144.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 v25.12 — official model reference and Weights table
sources.evidence: Read the exact page and its server-rendered React payload: the Weights row links this checkpoint and explicitly gives Parameters (B)=24, Active (B)=24, Apache 2.0, and Context Size=256k. Page identifies December 9, 2025, labs-devstral-small-2512, function calling and chat completions. It currently marks API deprecation February 27, 2026.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 — pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint uses Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration with a 40-layer ministral3 language decoder (hidden size 5120, intermediate size 32768, 32 attention heads, 8 KV heads) and a 24-layer Pixtral vision encoder plus projector. FP8 quantization excludes vision tower, projector and lm_head. max_position_embeddings=393216 and YaRN factor=48 with original length=8192; this is not the published recommended serving context.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 — pinned native configuration
sources.evidence: Native configuration independently confirms 40 decoder layers, 32 query/8 KV heads, hidden dimension 5120, dense feed-forward dimension 32768, a 24-layer vision encoder, and FP8 weights. max_position_embeddings=393216, YaRN factor=48 and original maximum=8192 agree with Transformers configuration.

sources.title: Mistral Vibe — Using offline models
sources.evidence: Mistral explicitly calls Devstral Small 2 a dense 24B model and provides a vLLM command for this exact checkpoint with native Mistral tool parsing. The separate Small 4 MoE figures are not transferred.

sources.title: Maintainer correction: remove unused reasoning tokens from Devstral Small 2
sources.evidence: Exact-repository commit by Mistral maintainer juliendenize on June 30, 2026 explicitly identifies this as non-reasoning. It replaces unused THINK tokens with reserved slots so tooling does not incorrectly mark it reasoning-capable; only tokenizer files changed. The associated discussion #29 identifies the author as Mistral AI organization staff.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 — Actual context length?
sources.evidence: Exact-model discussion #20: Mistral maintainer juliendenize explains the 393216 YaRN-derived config value versus the recommended 256k setting. On December 19, 2025, the maintainer explicitly instructs serving with --max-model-len 262144 and reports updating the README/params. Retain that documented setting rather than treating the higher config ceiling as the advertised context.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Live repository metadata reports public and ungated access at revision 55c5b41e98c2dbd21b0c8afffc540dcfc9eb5128. The file list contains the model card, configurations, both native and Transformers safetensors indexes and weight shards; there is no standalone LICENSE file. The Transformers index references six shards.

sources.title: Official Devstral Small 2 safetensors — bounded public-access probe
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated byte-range request returned HTTP 206, Content-Range bytes 0-7/4907440626, and exactly eight bytes containing the safetensors header length (12664 bytes). This verifies actual downloadable public weights without downloading a shard; it is not a learned-parameter count.

name.note: Official product name; this record maps to the December 2025 24B Instruct checkpoint, not the 123B sibling.

developer.note: Mistral AI announcement and official mistralai checkpoint; preserve the catalog developer label.

family.note: Announcement explicitly introduces the two sizes as the Devstral 2 coding-model family; normalize to the existing family key.

release_date.note: Explicit dated public release announcement corroborated by exact version reference; day precision.

open_weights.note: Official checkpoint is public and ungated and an unauthenticated bounded shard request succeeded.

license.note: Apache 2.0 is explicit in launch, checkpoint card metadata/body and exact weights row. Repository has no standalone LICENSE file; do not transfer the 123B sibling’s Modified MIT license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal billions, explicitly stated for Small 2. This is the developer-published model size, not a sum of FP8 storage/scale elements or a claim of exactly 24,000,000,000 learned weights.

active_parameters_b.note: Official exact-model Weights table separately labels Active (B)=24. This is direct nominal disclosure, not an inference that dense total equals active.

architecture.note: Official offline-model guide explicitly labels this exact model dense. The checkpoint independently shows the dense language decoder with Pixtral image encoder and projector; no MoE claim is transferred from another model.

context_window.note: Keep the explicitly recommended 262144-token serving context. Both configs currently contain the higher 393216 YaRN ceiling; the maintainer directly addresses that discrepancy and instructs --max-model-len 262144.

modalities.note: Launch and exact card explicitly support image and text input; checkpoint includes the native vision encoder/projector and language-generation head. Documented chat generation produces text, not native image/audio output. This differs from the text-only 123B sibling.

reasoning.note: Exact-model maintainer explicitly identifies it as non-reasoning and removes unused reasoning tokens. Agentic planning/tool use does not imply a dedicated reasoning mode.

tool_call.note: Exact checkpoint card supplies function definitions and native Mistral tool-call serving configuration; exact official model reference lists Function Calling.

description.value: Compact multimodal coding model for repository exploration, file editing, and software agents
description.note: Each clause is supported by the Small 2 announcement/card: compact 24B deployment, native vision, and code-agent repository/file tools. Preserve the existing description.

patch.notes: Mistral explicitly reports nominal 24B total and 24B active parameters for Devstral Small 2. The FP8 checkpoint storage aggregate is not an exact learned-parameter count. Native text/image input and text output; explicitly non-reasoning with native tool calls. Use the documented 262144-token context: a maintainer explicitly recommends that serving limit despite the 393216 YaRN ceiling in configuration. Official model docs mark API deprecation on February 27, 2026; public weights remain downloadable.

sources.label: Official model reference and Weights table

summary: Verified all 14 fields for the exact Devstral Small 2 December 2025 checkpoint. Fill nominal 24B total and separately disclosed 24B active parameters plus dense architecture, and replace the catalog release source with the dated primary announcement. Confirm Apache-2.0, public downloadable weights, text/image input and text output, native tools and explicitly non-reasoning status. Retain 262144 context using the maintainer clarification of the 393216 YaRN config discrepancy. No full weight shards downloaded or quantization storage totals misreported as parameters.
